name: Mackenzie down his river to the Arctic
traveler: Alexander Mackenzie and the English Chief
summary: A fur trader of the North West Company, guided by the Dene leader known as the English Chief, follows the great river flowing out of Great Slave Lake in the hope that it reaches the Pacific. In 102 days he travels it to the Arctic Ocean and back. He is said to have called it the River of Disappointment; it now bears his name.

stops.note: Four canoes set out from Lake Athabasca.
Down the Slave River; the lake is still half frozen.
Into the great river flowing west out of the lake.
The river turns north, not west to the Pacific.
Tides and white whales: the Arctic Ocean.
